## Articles — Microsoft Intune, Autopatch & Autopilot
- [Windows Autopatch & Hotpatch Enterprise Guide](https://blogs.akashnagapure.in/Blogs/Autopatchblog.html): Comprehensive step-by-step enterprise deployment guide for Windows Autopatch, modern ring management, and rebootless Hotpatching across Microsoft Intune.
- [Advanced Intune Deployment Rings](https://blogs.akashnagapure.in/Blogs/intune-advanced-deployment-rings.html): Design progressive Intune deployment rings around risk, validation windows, and rollback signals.
- [Windows Autopilot Troubleshooting Guide](https://blogs.akashnagapure.in/Blogs/intune-autopilot-troubleshooting.html): Comprehensive troubleshooting guide for Windows Autopilot deployment errors, hardware hash collection failures, and ESP timeout issues.
- [Intune Compliance Policy Architecture](https://blogs.akashnagapure.in/Blogs/intune-compliance-policies.html): Build Intune compliance policies with clear signals, grace periods, exclusions, and remediation paths.
- [Intune Win32 Packaging](https://blogs.akashnagapure.in/Blogs/intune-win32-packaging.html): A repeatable Intune Win32 application packaging workflow with detection, requirements, dependencies, and return codes.

## Articles — Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop & VMware
- [FSLogix Profile Containers in Enterprise AVD](https://blogs.akashnagapure.in/Blogs/avd-fslogix-profile-containers.html): Configure FSLogix profile containers with Azure Files and Azure NetApp Files for reliable, persistent user profiles in Azure Virtual Desktop.

- [VMware Horizon Instant Clone Architecture](https://blogs.akashnagapure.in/Blogs/vmware-horizon-instant-clones.html): Architect rapid desktop provisioning with VMware Horizon instant clones, golden image maintenance, and workspace delivery at enterprise scale.
- [Windows 365 Enterprise: Custom Image Deployment](https://blogs.akashnagapure.in/Blogs/windows-365-enterprise-provisioning.html): Step-by-step guide to Windows 365 Enterprise Cloud PC provisioning with custom device images, provisioning policies, and Microsoft Intune integration.
